AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:displayDescription: Hear where you are and what is around you, and start, stop and control your saved routes and beacons.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:instructions: Soundscape is a navigation aid for blind and partially sighted people. It describes the user's surroundings with 3D spatial audio through headphones, so that each street, place and beacon sounds from its real direction. Most functions answer by speaking through Soundscape itself: when a result succeeds with an empty message, Soundscape has already answered aloud, so say nothing more and do not describe the location in your own words, which would talk over it and lose the direction information. When the message is not empty, read it to the user. Functions other than listRoutes and listMarkers need Soundscape to be open; if it is not, the message asks the user to open it. Routes and beacons work only with routes and markers the user has already saved in Soundscape: it cannot search for new places or plan routes.
